document: Alone Against the Dark Defying the Triumph of the Ice (A Solo Play Call of Cthulhu Mini Campaign) Chaosium Publication 23154 (Matthew Costello, Mike Mason, Petr Štovik etc.) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
In a cleft of a ravine you find a pale white flower, the only thing 
growing for miles. It seems the most beautiful plant you have ever 
seen. You salute it, and take courage from it. Choose a direction, 
and drink a day’s water ration: for North, go to 213; for East, go 
to 210; for South, go to 214; for West, go to 235.
(213, 214, 235)
